description: Conducts a structured post-incident review following NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2 Post-Incident Activity guidance. Auto-invoked when an incident has been resolved and the team needs to conduct a blameless retrospective, reconstruct the timeline, perform root cause analysis, document lessons learned, and track remediation actions. Produces a PIR report with metrics (MTTD, MTTR, MTTC), control failure mapping, and actionable improvement plan.
